speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have multiple skin lesions; can you tell me how long they have been present and if they are itchy, painful, or changing in appearance? Also, have you noticed any fever, fatigue, or other systemic symptoms recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chickenpox (Varicella).

Given the patient's daycare exposure to similar lesions and her brother's recent chickenpox infection, despite up-to-date immunizations, the presentation of multiple painless, nonpruritic papules is highly suggestive of varicella. I am requesting images of the lesions to confirm the characteristic evolution of the rash. REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_Lesions
